controls: Breadth pause is not world closure.
Navigation saturation is not ontology completion.
All nine real edge identities fit existing ten-region navigation and do not alter anchors.
No new MajorRegion or owner coverage mapping is required.
A single new discipline, catalog symmetry, trend or owner-name resemblance cannot reopen breadth expansion.
Reopen requires structural pressure such as repeated unplaceable clusters, crosswalk reference gaps, degraded navigation, or multi-source structural shift.
nonTriggers: Desire for catalog completeness or symmetry.
An owner project name resembling an external field.
A new publication or trendy topic without stable independent field evidence.
Unmapped owner research when current authority itself is absent.

reopenTriggers.condition: Three or more independently verified high-value identities repeatedly fail meaningful placement in all current MajorRegions.
Real user/agent navigation fixtures show current ten-region projections no longer compress/recover exploration effectively.
A current owner repeatedly exposes mature semantics with no adequate ReferenceIdentity or navigation coordinate after external verification.
Multiple independent authoritative/professional sources expose a stable knowledge-space organization not representable by current graph/regions.
A future edge cluster becomes deletion-essential enough to justify splitting one current social/cultural navigation projection.
